description: Things the jabberwock was taught, filed under 'two_axes'. Written by the teach() facility (one node per taught item).

attrs.name: capability_axis
attrs.definition: what the program DOES — graded by the axioms 0->3
attrs.gifted_or_earned: can be GIFTED (a savant has capability without earning understanding)

attrs.name: understanding_axis
attrs.definition: a reflective GRIP on the program — inspect / extract / teach / model-others
attrs.orthogonal_to: capability (it is NOT a capability rung; it crosses every capability level)
attrs.served_by: extraction+teaching (fold 3) + law-vs-cache certification (fold 1, which certifies a faculty IS capability-3/a law)
attrs.gifted_or_earned: must be EARNED — the cost (extraction/teaching) is constitutive; it cannot be gifted

attrs.name: savant_case
attrs.claim: the SAVANT runs a universal law (capability-3) yet holds NO reflective model of it (understanding-0) — 'memory without reckoning'. This proves capability and understanding are INDEPENDENT axes, not one ladder.
attrs.model_others: lives on the UNDERSTANDING axis, NOT capability — a savant is capability-3 and CANNOT model others

attrs.name: mastery_case
attrs.claim: MASTERY = high on BOTH axes — runs the universal law AND holds an extractable, teachable, model-others reflective grip on it. The savant is capability-3/understanding-0; the master is capability-3/understanding-3.

attrs.name: capability_understanding_mt
attrs.axes: capability (axioms 0->3, what the program does) and understanding (orthogonal reflective grip)
attrs.independence: INDEPENDENT — the savant_case (capability-3, understanding-0) is the proof; mastery_case is high on both
attrs.capability_served_by: escalation_cascade (fold 4: order-(n-x) default + confidence-gated escalation) + growth (fold 2: compression-gated minting)
attrs.understanding_served_by: extraction+teaching (fold 3: reify a faculty as a runnable Program, teach it) + law_vs_cache (fold 1: certify a faculty IS capability-3/a law by invariance-under-intervention)
attrs.earned_vs_gifted: capability can be GIFTED; understanding must be EARNED (its cost is constitutive)
attrs.unification: the four prior folds are the two axes' machinery: folds 2+4 grow/run the CAPABILITY axis; folds 1+3 certify/extract/teach the UNDERSTANDING axis
